decisions.reason: The page 11 crop adjustment changes tree visibility but does not change which photos must be included or where the currently specified photos must be placed.
The page 11 photo crop does not alter the required background treatment for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
The source requests a localized photo-crop correction and does not change the document-wide layout, formatting, coverage, or design strategy.
Changing the page 11 photo crop does not affect the Agua Arc identity, logo, or color requirements.
The source concerns only tree visibility within a photo crop and does not resolve or change any typeface, font-size, or bolding rule.
A slight zoom-out within the existing page 11 photo does not necessarily change the document page count, spacing, or page-limit compliance state.
The photo-crop instruction does not change Canva ownership, editing access, asset restrictions, or the editable-source deliverable.
The page-specific crop correction does not alter the deferred reusable-template requirement or any of its modularity rules.
The source does not affect any proposal table, budget sheet, replacement table, or table-row requirement.
The page 11 photo-crop correction does not change the number, location, or integration method of team biographies.
The page 11 photo crop does not alter the one-page proposal letter or the client's ability to insert a signature in Canva.
The source does not change the requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
